Open Source News brings open source and software development news from many sources into one clean, fast feed.

WHAT YOU GET
• Today: Top, Latest and Most Discussed. The biggest releases, the newest projects, and what developers are talking about.
• Full Coverage: see how every outlet reports the same story, side by side
• Top Stories: the day's biggest stories, full screen, one tap at a time
• Topics: follow Linux, programming languages, databases, cloud, security and more, and your Today feed follows you
• Explore and search every story and topic
• Saved: keep stories for later
• Story notifications: a few stories a day, picked from what you read, and quiet at night
• Reading settings: text size, typeface, spacing and page color, with light and dark mode
• Designed for iPhone and iPad

FREE, WITH AN AD-FREE OPTION
Open Source News is free and supported by ads. Remove all ads with a monthly or yearly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed or canceled in your Apple Account settings.

Every headline links to the original publisher.

Questions or ideas: support@newsfusion.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.loyal.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
